events_state_change_payload_sufficient.name: events_state_change_payload_sufficient
events_state_change_payload_sufficient.value: "events"."kind" <> 'status-changed' OR ("events"."transition" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."diff" IS NOT NULL)

objects_mirror_identity_complete.name: objects_mirror_identity_complete
objects_mirror_identity_complete.value: "objects"."archetype" <> 'mirror' OR ("objects"."external_source" IS NOT NULL AND "objects"."external_id" IS NOT NULL)

objects_mirror_not_schedulable.name: objects_mirror_not_schedulable
objects_mirror_not_schedulable.value: "objects"."archetype" <> 'mirror' OR ("objects"."cron" IS NULL AND "objects"."assignee_user_id" IS NULL)

outbox_actions_approval_required.name: outbox_actions_approval_required
outbox_actions_approval_required.value: "outbox_actions"."consequence_class" NOT IN ('R3','R4') OR "outbox_actions"."approval_event" IS NOT NULL
